Generic End User Certificate: Wherever Bidders are insisting for End User Certificate from the Buyer, same shall be provided in Buyer’s standard format only. 7. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 7 Shelf Life. On the date of supply, minimum 7 usable shelf life should be available / balance.
